description: This file defines data models, enums, and utility functions for dynamic form properties in the Thingsboard project, including property types, property containers, and schema conversion functions.

methods.name: cleanupFormProperties
methods.description: Cleans up an array of form properties by removing unnecessary or invalid attributes based on property type.

methods.name: cleanupFormProperty
methods.description: Cleans up a single form property by removing attributes not relevant to its type.

methods.name: toPropertyGroups
methods.description: Converts a list of form properties into grouped property containers for UI rendering.

methods.name: toPropertyContainers
methods.description: Converts form properties into container elements like fields, rows, fieldsets, or HTML sections.

methods.name: isPropertyTypeAllowedForRow
methods.description: Checks if a property type is allowed within a row layout.

methods.name: isSingleFieldPropertyType
methods.description: Determines if a property type is a single input field.

methods.name: isInputFieldPropertyType
methods.description: Checks if a property type is an input field suitable for user data entry.

methods.name: defaultFormProperties
methods.description: Generates default values for a list of form properties.

methods.name: defaultFormPropertyValue
methods.description: Provides a default value based on property type.

methods.name: propertyValid
methods.description: Validates if a form property has essential attributes.

methods.name: defaultPropertyValue
methods.description: Returns a default value for a given property type.

methods.name: formPropertyCompletions
methods.description: Creates autocomplete suggestions for form properties.

methods.name: formPropertyCompletion
methods.description: Generates a completion object for a specific form property.

methods.name: formPropertyCompletionType
methods.description: Determines the string representation of a property type for completions.

methods.name: jsonFormSchemaToFormProperties
methods.description: Converts a JSON schema into form property definitions.

methods.name: schemaFormToProperties
methods.description: Maps schema and form definitions into form properties.

methods.name: jsonFormDataToProperty
methods.description: Converts JSON form data into a form property object.
